location_fine: home living room and a bar/restaurant
visual_synopsis: A family watches TV in their living room - a mustached father in a patterned sweater, a woman in a blue floral top, and a boy in a red shirt - before the father puts on a leather jacket, leaves through the hallway, and goes downstairs to a bar/restaurant area with an arcade game, where he sits alone drinking whiskey while the boy watches from the stairs.
